create_import_tasks: create a REST API endpoint that imports labeling tasks from JSON, CSV, or TSV files into a Label Studio project
import_predictions: import model predictions into a Label Studio project with memory-efficient batch processing and validation
reimport_tasks: re-import tasks for a project using previously uploaded file IDs, replacing existing tasks
manage_file_uploads: list, retrieve, update, and delete file uploads associated with a Label Studio project
download_uploaded_files: download uploaded files with authenticated access, supporting NGINX proxy or direct streaming modes
